verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party 'Filters & Rules' help article, and a community comment about migrating filters and rules confirms the feature exists, but the pack shows nothing of what triggers or actions rules support. JMAP EventSource/WebPush is a developer building block, and snooze is a separate feature, so neither is credited. Missing for 10: documented trigger conditions and action types, detail on how incoming-mail events fire rules, and hands-on corroboration of automation depth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Migrating filters and rules over, on the other hand...
